mentions.name: LearnMathsToday
mentions.description: An AI-powered maths practice app that marks handwritten solutions step-by-step (not just the final answer) so students learn the process. It focuses on Singapore's O-Level maths curriculum with adaptive learning paths and photo-based problem solving, aiming to make structured, curriculum-aligned maths practice as habit-forming and accessible as Duolingo made language learning. The builder also runs an associated YouTube channel of free lessons that has crossed 150K views.
mentions.audience: Students studying Singapore's O-Level maths curriculum
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on LearnMathsToday – think Duolingo but for maths. It's an AI-powered app that marks your handwritten solutions step-by-step (not just the final answer), so students actually learn the process.

mentions.name: LearnMathsToday
mentions.description: Mobile app that helps students learn math in a fun, engaging, self-paced way. It generates AI questions that adapt to each student's level and uses AI-powered marking to give instant feedback on written answers. Gamification features (points, levels, and a storyline) keep students motivated, and content follows the Singapore syllabus.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on LearnMathsToday, a mobile app that helps students learn math in a fun and engaging way. It’s self-paced, with AI-generated questions that adapt to each student’s level. One unique feature is AI-powered marking, which gives instant feedback on written answers. I’ve also added gamification—points, levels, and a storyline—to keep students motivated. Right now, the app is based on the Singapore syllabus, since I’m based in Singapore.
